payload.posture: Read 2 Samuel 21:1–14 as one movement in Saul's story, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states an earlier attack on Gibeonites, an oath, seven descendants, Rizpah’s vigil, recovered bones, family burial, and answered prayer bind past violence to later consequence. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of Saul's story.
